messages.subject: Project Lyra – MSSA v1 for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Attached is the first full draft of the Master Software and Services Agreement (v1), with SOW-1, the SLA, charges and DPA as schedules. A few points to flag for you:

• Liability cap is currently set at 12 months' Charges (clause 10.3) — expect Pennland to push on this.
• Availability SLA is 99.5%; service-credit cap 10% of quarterly subscription.
• We've reserved Verdant's right to use anonymised/aggregated data (clause 6.3).

Once you're happy we'll send to Denham Lewis.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
